```
theorem runEntry_reconstruct {K : ℕ} {S H : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (q : S) (f : S → H) (d : Turing.Cfg K Bool H x) (hd : d.state = some (f q)) :
    (d.mapState (fun _ => q)).mapState f = d := by
  apply Cfg.mapState_eq_of_fields
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, hd, Option.map_some, Option.map_some]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos]
  · funext j p
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes]
  · funext j
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_output]

end WordRAM.Sim
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/RAMSimulation/Sim/RunHost.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.RAMSimulation.Sim.RunPhase
import TCSlib.Complexity.RAMSimulation.Sim.Startup
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.NDHost
import Mathlib.Data.List.GetD

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The finite position and parity host of the RAM simulation

The host runs the start-up and then instruction phases indexed by a program position and an
alternating parity. Every dispatch flips parity, including a jump to the current position.
Positions beyond the program are represented by its final rejecting position.

## Main definitions

The instruction phases use one common immediate-address width depending only on the program.

## Main results

* `WordRAM.Sim.runProgram_immBound`: a finite program admits one such address width.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (Exercise 1.9; §2.1.2.)
-/

namespace WordRAM.Sim

open Turing

/-- A finite program has one positive address width covering every fetched instruction,
including the default rejection past the end.

**Proof sketch.** Take the maximum absolute value of twice an immediate address, and choose
one more bit than that maximum. `Nat.lt_two_pow_self` bounds it by the corresponding power of
two. The empty immediate list of the default rejection needs no bound. -/
theorem runProgram_immBound (P : XProgram) :
    ∃ a : ℕ, 1 ≤ a ∧ ∀ p : ℕ, ImmBound a (P.getD p (.base .reject)) := by
  classical
  let addresses := (P.flatMap immediates).toFinset
  let m := addresses.sup (fun z => (2 * z).natAbs)
  refine ⟨m + 1, Nat.succ_pos _, ?_⟩
  intro p
  rw [immBound_iff]
  intro z hz
  by_cases hp : p < P.length
  · have hmem : P.getD p (.base .reject) ∈ P := by
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem P (.base .reject) hp]
      exact List.getElem_mem hp
    have hzmem : z ∈ addresses := List.mem_toFinset.mpr (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨_, hmem, hz⟩)
    have habs : (2 * z).natAbs ≤ m := Finset.le_sup (f := fun z : ℤ => (2 * z).natAbs) hzmem
    have hpow : (m : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ (m + 1) := by
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_succ_self m).trans (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := m + 1))
    have hupper : 2 * z ≤ ((2 * z).natAbs : ℤ) := Int.le_natAbs
    have hneg : -(2 * z) ≤ ((-(2 * z)).natAbs : ℤ) := Int.le_natAbs
    rw [Int.natAbs_neg] at hneg
    rw [inRange_iff]
    constructor <;> omega
  · rw [List.getD_eq_default P (.base .reject) (Nat.le_of_not_gt hp), immediates_def] at hz
    cases hz

/-- The start-up and the finite family of uniform instruction phases chosen for one program.
The word-size witness remains a parameter, so the host is independent of input and bounds. -/
structure RunSetup (P : XProgram) (fn : Bool) (Mw : FinTM Bool) where
  width : ℕ
  width_pos : 1 ≤ width
  bounded : ∀ p : ℕ, ImmBound width (P.getD p (.base .reject))
  extraTapes : ℕ
  StartState : Type
  finiteStart : Fintype StartState
  decidableStart : DecidableEq StartState
  startup : MultiTapeTM (8 + extraTapes) Bool StartState
  startEntry : StartState
  startExit : StartState
  startCost : ℕ
  start_correct : ∀ (x : List Bool) (W tw sw : ℕ), Mw.ComputesInTime x (Nat.bits W) tw →
    Mw.tm.spaceUsed (Mw.tm.initCfg x) tw ≤ sw →
    ∃ (t : ℕ) (o : Fin 8 → ℤ), t ≤ tw + startCost * (x.length + W ^ 2 + 1) ∧
      (∀ s < t, (startup.runFrom (Turing.Cfg.init startEntry x) s).state ≠ some startExit) ∧
      (startup.runFrom (Turing.Cfg.init startEntry x) t).state = some startExit ∧
      Encodes width fn {-1} (XCfg.init W x.length) (Fin.castAddEmb extraTapes) o
        (startup.runFrom (Turing.Cfg.init startEntry x) t) ∧
      startup.spaceUsed (Turing.Cfg.init startEntry x) t ≤
        sw + startCost * (W + (Nat.bits x.length).length + 1)
  phases : (p : Fin (P.length + 1)) → RunPhase width fn (P.getD p.val (.base .reject))

attribute [instance] RunSetup.finiteStart RunSetup.decidableStart

/-- The approved start-up and instruction interfaces supply a finite setup for every program
and word-size witness. The choices of phases are made once for the whole finite program. -/
theorem exists_runSetup (P : XProgram) (fn : Bool) (Mw : FinTM Bool) :
    Nonempty (RunSetup P fn Mw) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hbound⟩ := runProgram_immBound P
  obtain ⟨k', S, hfin, hdec, R, entry, exit, C, hstart⟩ := exists_startup a ha fn Mw
  exact ⟨{
    width := a
    width_pos := ha
    bounded := hbound
    extraTapes := k'
    StartState := S
    finiteStart := hfin
    decidableStart := hdec
    startup := R
    startEntry := entry
    startExit := exit
    startCost := C
    start_correct := hstart
    phases := fun p => Classical.choice (exists_runPhase a fn _ (hbound p.val)) }⟩

/-- The finite representative of a program position: positions past the program are clamped
to the final rejecting position. -/
@[simps (config := { isSimp := false }) val]
def runPosition (P : XProgram) (p : ℕ) : Fin (P.length + 1) :=
  ⟨min p P.length, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (min_le_right _ _)⟩

/-- Clamping a position leaves its fetched instruction unchanged: both a clamped endpoint
and every position beyond it fetch the default rejection. -/
theorem runPosition_fetch (P : XProgram) (p : ℕ) :
    P.getD (runPosition P p).val (.base .reject) = P.getD p (.base .reject) := by
  rw [runPosition_val]
  by_cases hp : p ≤ P.length
  · rw [min_eq_left hp]
  · rw [min_eq_right (Nat.le_of_not_ge hp), List.getD_eq_default P (.base .reject) le_rfl,
      List.getD_eq_default P (.base .reject) (Nat.le_of_not_ge hp)]

namespace RunSetup

variable {P : XProgram} {fn : Bool} {Mw : FinTM Bool} (A : RunSetup P fn Mw)

/-- The host's phase indices consist of the start-up and position/parity pairs. -/
abbrev Index := Option (Fin (P.length + 1) × Bool)

/-- The phase-index type is an optional position/parity pair. -/
theorem index_eq : Index (P := P) = Option (Fin (P.length + 1) × Bool) := rfl

/-- The control-state type of a phase: start-up states, or the instruction's states.
This reducible type notation keeps dependent tags usable in the simulation's other files. -/
abbrev PhaseState : Index (P := P) → Type
  | none => A.StartState
  | some (p, _) => (A.phases p).State

/-- The start-up phase uses its chosen state type. -/
theorem phaseState_none : A.PhaseState none = A.StartState := rfl

/-- A position/parity phase uses that position's instruction state type. -/
theorem phaseState_some (p : Fin (P.length + 1)) (par : Bool) :
    A.PhaseState (some (p, par)) = (A.phases p).State := rfl

instance phaseFintype (i : Index (P := P)) : Fintype (A.PhaseState i) :=
  match i with
  | none => A.finiteStart
  | some (p, _) => (A.phases p).finiteState

instance phaseDecidableEq (i : Index (P := P)) : DecidableEq (A.PhaseState i) :=
  match i with
  | none => A.decidableStart
  | some (p, _) => (A.phases p).decidableState

/-- The host's phase machines: a deterministic start-up and embedded instruction phases. -/
def phase : (i : Index (P := P)) → NDTM (8 + A.extraTapes) Bool (A.PhaseState i)
  | none => A.startup.toNDTM
  | some (p, _) => runEmbedND (Fin.castAddEmb A.extraTapes) (A.phases p).machine

/-- The start-up machine is the deterministic embedding of the chosen start-up. -/
theorem phase_none : A.phase none = A.startup.toNDTM := rfl

/-- The instruction at a position is embedded on the first eight tapes. -/
theorem phase_some (p : Fin (P.length + 1)) (par : Bool) :
    A.phase (some (p, par)) = runEmbedND (Fin.castAddEmb A.extraTapes) (A.phases p).machine := rfl

/-- The host's state type is the disjoint union of its finite phase state types. -/
abbrev State := Σ i : Index (P := P), A.PhaseState i

/-- The host state type, as its dependent-sum expression. -/
theorem state_eq : A.State = (Σ i : Index (P := P), A.PhaseState i) := rfl

/-- The entry tag reached by a next/jump dispatch. Every dispatch changes parity. -/
def resumeTag (p : Fin (P.length + 1)) (par jump : Bool) : A.State :=
  let p' := runPosition P (if jump then jumpTarget (P.getD p.val (.base .reject)) else p.val + 1)
  ⟨some (p', !par), (A.phases p').entry⟩

/-- The next/jump destination is the clamped target, with opposite parity and its phase entry. -/
theorem resumeTag_eq (p : Fin (P.length + 1)) (par jump : Bool) :
    A.resumeTag p par jump =
      let p' := runPosition P
        (if jump then jumpTarget (P.getD p.val (.base .reject)) else p.val + 1)
      ⟨some (p', !par), (A.phases p').entry⟩ := rfl

/-- The redirect table: leave the start-up at its exit, and otherwise use the instruction's
next/jump tag. Verdict phases have no redirect. -/
def redirect : (i : Index (P := P)) → A.PhaseState i → Option A.State
  | none, q => if q = A.startExit then some ⟨some (0, false), (A.phases 0).entry⟩ else none
  | some (p, par), q => ((A.phases p).redirect q).map (A.resumeTag p par)

/-- A start-up state redirects exactly when it is the designated exit. -/
theorem redirect_none (q : A.StartState) :
    A.redirect none q =
      if q = A.startExit then some ⟨some (0, false), (A.phases 0).entry⟩ else none := rfl

/-- An instruction redirect tags its chosen next/jump destination in the host. -/
theorem redirect_some (p : Fin (P.length + 1)) (par : Bool) (q : (A.phases p).State) :
    A.redirect (some (p, par)) q = ((A.phases p).redirect q).map (A.resumeTag p par) := rfl

/-- The simulation's nondeterministic phase host, entered at the chosen start-up entry. -/
def host : NDTM (8 + A.extraTapes) Bool A.State :=
  NDTM.phaseHostND A.phase ⟨none, A.startEntry⟩ A.redirect

/-- A deterministic slice of the simulation host is the existing deterministic phase host
of the same slices. This is the interface used to transfer deterministic phase contracts. -/
theorem host_fixChoice (b : Bool) :
    A.host.fixChoice b = phaseHostTM (fun i => (A.phase i).fixChoice b)
      ⟨none, A.startEntry⟩ A.redirect := by
  rw [host, NDTM.phaseHostND_fixChoice]

/-- The simulation host starts in the tagged start-up entry. -/
theorem host_q₀ : A.host.q₀ = ⟨none, A.startEntry⟩ := by
  calc A.host.q₀ = (A.host.fixChoice false).q₀ := (NDTM.fixChoice_q₀ _ _).symm
    _ = ⟨none, A.startEntry⟩ := by rw [host_fixChoice, phaseHostTM_q₀]

/-- A branch of the simulation host is a branch of the chosen standard phase host. -/
theorem host_runWith {x : List Bool} (w : List Bool)
    (d : Turing.Cfg (8 + A.extraTapes) Bool A.State x) :
    A.host.runWith w d =
      (NDTM.phaseHostND A.phase ⟨none, A.startEntry⟩ A.redirect).runWith w d := rfl

/-- The simulation host bundled with its finite state type and fixed number of tapes. -/
@[simps (config := { isSimp := false }) k State tm]
def finHost : FinNDTM Bool := ⟨8 + A.extraTapes, A.State, A.host⟩

end RunSetup

end WordRAM.Sim
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/RAMSimulation/Sim/RunInduction.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.RAMSimulation.Sim.RunPrefix

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The shared RAM simulation induction

One fuel induction applies to arbitrary timed branch choices and to branches realizing a
prescribed source coin stream. Every instruction uses the published phase host and restores
the work heads before the next instruction. The resulting certificate contains exact source
touches, consumed coins and uniform time and head bounds.

## Main definitions

No additional machine or execution relation is introduced.

## Main results

* `WordRAM.Sim.RunSetup.run_execution`: a driven execution certificate for every fuel bound.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (Exercise 1.9; §2.1.2; Definition 4.1.)
-/

namespace WordRAM.Sim.RunSetup

open Turing

/-- Every encoded instruction entry admits a driven simulation prefix. It either completes a
verdict before the fuel bound or reaches exactly that many ordinary source steps. Its source
trace works for every stream agreeing with the coins consumed by this prefix.
[AB09, Exercise 1.9], with explicit resource and read-once coin invariants.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on fuel. At zero, use the empty live certificate. At positive fuel,
`instruction_run` executes the next instruction using the driver's entry bit. A verdict gives
`RunExecution.of_verdict`. Otherwise update the consumed prefix with `runNextCoins`, use
`source_step_rd` to identify the successor coin index, and apply the induction hypothesis at
the restored encoded successor. `RunExecution.prepend` concatenates the actual branch and
source trace while keeping one common head envelope. -/
theorem run_execution {P : XProgram} {fn : Bool} {Mw : FinTM Bool}
    (A : RunSetup P fn Mw) {W : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (D : RunDriver W)
    (B : ℕ → Bool → Prop) (hD : D.Respects B) (s fuel : ℕ) (T : Finset ℤ)
    (c : XCfg W) (o : Fin 8 → ℤ)
    (d : Turing.Cfg (8 + A.extraTapes) Bool A.State x) (coins : List Bool) (par : Bool)
    (hrd : c.rd = coins.length) (hc : RunCoinsSatisfy B coins)
    (hd : d.state = some ⟨some (runPosition P c.pc, par),
      (A.phases (runPosition P c.pc)).entry⟩)
    (he : Encodes A.width fn T c (Fin.castAddEmb A.extraTapes) o d) :
    Nonempty (RunExecution A D B s fuel T c o d coins) := by
  induction fuel generalizing s T c d coins par with
  | zero => exact RunExecution.zero A D B s T c o d coins par hrd hc hd he
  | succ fuel ih =>
    let b := D.coin s c
    have hcoin : isCoin (P.getD c.pc (.base .reject)) = true →
        (coins ++ [b]).getD c.rd false = D.coin s c := by
      intro _
      rw [hrd]
      exact runCoinsAgree_append_bit coins (coins ++ [b]) b (runCoinsAgree_refl _)
    obtain ⟨w, e, ht, hr, henv, hfollows, hresult⟩ :=
      A.instruction_run (ρ := coins ++ [b]) D s par T c o d hd he hcoin
    cases hs : xstep P x (coins ++ [b]) c with
    | inl c' =>
      rw [hs] at hresult
      obtain ⟨he', hd', hh⟩ := hresult
      have hrd' : c'.rd = (runNextCoins (P.getD c.pc (.base .reject)) coins b).length := by
        rw [source_step_rd hs, hrd, runNextCoins_length]
      have hc' : RunCoinsSatisfy B (runNextCoins (P.getD c.pc (.base .reject)) coins b) :=
        runNextCoins_satisfy B _ coins b hc
          (by rw [← hrd]; exact (RunDriver.respects_iff D B).mp hD s c)
      obtain ⟨R⟩ := ih (s + w.length) (T ∪ (P.getD c.pc (.base .reject)).touches c.mem)
        c' e (runNextCoins (P.getD c.pc (.base .reject)) coins b) (!par) hrd' hc' hd' he'
      exact RunExecution.prepend A D B s fuel T c c' o d e coins w b hrd hs hr hh ht
        henv hfollows R
    | inr v =>
      rw [hs] at hresult
      exact RunExecution.of_verdict A D B s fuel T c o d e coins w v hrd hc hs hr
        hresult.1 hresult.2 ht henv hfollows

end WordRAM.Sim.RunSetup
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/RAMSimulation/Sim/RunInput.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.RAMSimulation.Sim.RunInduction
import TCSlib.Complexity.RAMSimulation.Sim.RunStartup
import TCSlib.Complexity.RAMSimulation.Sim.RunBounds

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# From the input configuration to a completed simulation

Start-up is followed by the shared execution induction. A halting source stream agreeing
with the consumed coins closes the live-cutoff alternative and supplies the source output.
The branch and its bounds apply to both timed schedules and prescribed coin streams.

## Main definitions

No further machine is introduced.

## Main results

* `WordRAM.Sim.RunSetup.input_run`: a complete, bounded driven branch from the input.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (Exercise 1.9; §2.1.2; Definition 4.1.)
-/

namespace WordRAM.Sim.RunSetup

open Turing

/-- A driver respecting a coin predicate realizes a bounded complete source run whenever
every permitted consumed prefix has an agreeing halting stream. A schedule-following driver
also makes the resulting word an initial slice of that schedule.
[AB09, Exercise 1.9], with explicit additive startup costs and visited-cell space.

**Proof sketch.** `startup_run` reaches the first encoded instruction with one stationary
dispatch. Apply `run_execution` with the RAM time bound as fuel. The supplied halting stream
and `RunExecution.completed` rule out a live cutoff, bound the exact touched cells by `f`,
and identify the output. Concatenate the actual branch words. `runSpace_append_le` counts
startup once and one common head interval per tape; `time_total_le` and `space_total_le`
absorb the fixed coefficients into the stated polynomials. -/
theorem input_run {P : XProgram} {fn : Bool} {Mw : FinTM Bool}
    (A : RunSetup P fn Mw) {W : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (tw sw t f : ℕ)
    (hW : Mw.ComputesInTime x (Nat.bits W) tw)
    (hS : Mw.tm.spaceUsed (Mw.tm.initCfg x) tw ≤ sw)
    (D : RunDriver W) (B : ℕ → Bool → Prop) (hD : D.Respects B)
    (Q : List Bool → Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (hhalt : ∀ coins, RunCoinsSatisfy B coins →
      ∃ ρ, RunCoinsAgree coins ρ ∧ ∃ v out, HaltsWithin P x ρ W t v out f ∧ Q ρ v out) :
    ∃ (w : List Bool) (e : Turing.Cfg (8 + A.extraTapes) Bool A.State x)
      (ρ : List Bool) (v : Bool) (out : List Bool),
      HaltsWithin P x ρ W t v out f ∧ Q ρ v out ∧ A.host.runWith w (A.host.initCfg x) = e ∧
      e.state = none ∧ e.output = (if fn then out else [v]) ∧
      w.length ≤ tw + A.boundCost * (t + 1) * (f * (W + 1) + W ^ 2 + x.length + 1) ∧
      A.host.spaceUsedWith w (A.host.initCfg x) ≤
        sw + A.boundCost * (f * (W + 1) + W + Complexity.logSpace x.length + 1) ∧
      (∀ χ, D.Follows χ → w = runChoices χ 0 w.length) := by
  let c := XCfg.init W x.length
  obtain ⟨t₀, o, d, ht₀, hr₀, hd, he, hs₀⟩ :=
    A.startup_run x W tw sw hW hS (D.word 0 c) (D.word_length 0 c) D.dispatch
  let w₀ := D.word 0 c t₀ ++ [D.dispatch t₀]
  have hw₀ : w₀.length = t₀ + 1 := by
    rw [List.length_append, D.word_length, List.length_singleton]
  have hpos : runPosition P c.pc = 0 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    rw [runPosition_val]
    dsimp only [c]
    rw [XCfg.init_def]
    exact Nat.zero_min _
  have hrd : c.rd = ([] : List Bool).length := by dsimp only [c]; rw [XCfg.init_def]; rfl
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := A.run_execution D B hD w₀.length t {-1} c o d [] false hrd
    (runCoinsSatisfy_nil B) (by rw [hpos]; exact hd) he
  obtain ⟨ρ, ha, v, out, hsource, hQ⟩ := hhalt R.outCoins R.coins_ok
  obtain ⟨hlt, hc, hdone, hout⟩ := R.completed hsource ha
  have hcard : ({-1} ∪ R.cells).card ≤ f + 1 := by
    have hu := Finset.card_union_le ({-1} : Finset ℤ) R.cells
    rw [Finset.card_singleton] at hu
    omega
  refine ⟨w₀ ++ R.word, R.finish, ρ, v, out, hsource, hQ, ?_, hdone, hout, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [NDTM.runWith_append, hr₀, R.run]
  · rw [List.length_append]
    have hraw : w₀.length + R.word.length ≤
        tw + A.startCost * (x.length + W ^ 2 + 1) + 1 +
          (R.steps + 1) * A.blockTime x.length W ({-1} ∪ R.cells).card := by
      have ht := R.time_bound
      omega
    exact hraw.trans (A.time_total_le x.length W tw t f _ R.steps hcard hlt)
  · have hspace := runSpace_append_le A.host w₀ R.word (A.host.initCfg x) d
      (A.blockRadius x.length W ({-1} ∪ R.cells).card) hr₀ R.envelope
    exact hspace.trans ((Nat.add_le_add_right hs₀ _).trans
      (A.space_total_le x.length W sw f _ hcard))
  · intro χ hDχ
    obtain ⟨hw, hdispatch⟩ := (RunDriver.follows_iff D χ).mp hDχ
    have hstart : w₀ = runChoices χ 0 w₀.length := by
      rw [hw₀]
      change D.word 0 c t₀ ++ [D.dispatch t₀] = runChoices χ 0 (t₀ + 1)
      rw [hw 0 c t₀, hdispatch t₀, runChoices_append χ 0 t₀ 1, Nat.zero_add, runChoices_one]
    calc
      w₀ ++ R.word = runChoices χ 0 w₀.length ++ runChoices χ w₀.length R.word.length :=
        congrArg₂ List.append hstart (R.follows χ hDχ)
      _ = runChoices χ 0 (w₀.length + R.word.length) := by
        rw [runChoices_append, Nat.zero_add]
      _ = runChoices χ 0 (w₀ ++ R.word).length :=
        congrArg (runChoices χ 0) (List.length_append (as := w₀) (bs := R.word)).symm

end WordRAM.Sim.RunSetup
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/RAMSimulation/Sim/RunInstruction.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.RAMSimulation.Sim.RunStep
import TCSlib.Complexity.RAMSimulation.Sim.RunDriver
import TCSlib.Complexity.RAMSimulation.Sim.RunCosts

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# One instruction under either choice driver

This is the common step interface for the master execution induction. An ordinary phase
dispatches and restores all heads; a verdict phase halts. Both cases have the same uniform
time and radius bounds, and words from a timed schedule remain actual slices of that schedule.

## Main definitions

No further machine is constructed here.

## Main results

* `WordRAM.Sim.RunSetup.instruction_run`: the uniform driven instruction step.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (Exercise 1.9; §2.1.2; Definition 4.1.)
-/

namespace WordRAM.Sim.RunSetup

open Turing

variable {P : XProgram} {fn : Bool} {Mw : FinTM Bool} (A : RunSetup P fn Mw)

/-- Execute one source instruction using driver `D` at absolute time `s`. The supplied stream
agrees with the driver's coin at this instruction. A continuing endpoint restores all heads
and encodes its successor; a verdict endpoint is halted with the correct output. If the driver
follows a schedule, the entire word, including a dispatch when present, is its timed slice.

**Proof sketch.** Case on the source step and use `host_ordinary` or `host_verdict` with the
driver's words and entry bit. The finite maximum coefficient gives `blockTime` and
`blockRadius` by `phase_time_le` and `phase_radius_le`. In the ordinary case, concatenate the
phase slice and its one-bit dispatch by `runChoices_append`; the verdict case is one slice. -/
theorem instruction_run {x ρ : List Bool} {W : ℕ} (D : RunDriver W) (s : ℕ) (par : Bool)
    (T : Finset ℤ) (c : XCfg W) (o : Fin 8 → ℤ)
    (d : Turing.Cfg (8 + A.extraTapes) Bool A.State x)
    (hd : d.state = some ⟨some (runPosition P c.pc, par),
      (A.phases (runPosition P c.pc)).entry⟩)
    (he : Encodes A.width fn T c (Fin.castAddEmb A.extraTapes) o d)
    (hcoin : isCoin (P.getD c.pc (.base .reject)) = true →
      ρ.getD c.rd false = D.coin s c) :
    ∃ (w : List Bool) (d' : Turing.Cfg (8 + A.extraTapes) Bool A.State x),
      w.length ≤ A.blockTime x.length W T.card ∧ A.host.runWith w d = d' ∧
      (∀ u ≤ w.length, ∀ j,
        |(A.host.runWith (w.take u) d).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤
          (A.blockRadius x.length W T.card : ℕ)) ∧
      (∀ χ, D.Follows χ → w = runChoices χ s w.length) ∧
      match xstep P x ρ c with
      | .inl c' => Encodes A.width fn (T ∪ (P.getD c.pc (.base .reject)).touches c.mem) c'
          (Fin.castAddEmb A.extraTapes) o d' ∧
          d'.state = some ⟨some (runPosition P c'.pc, !par),
            (A.phases (runPosition P c'.pc)).entry⟩ ∧ d'.workTapePos = d.workTapePos
      | .inr v => d'.state = none ∧ d'.output = (if fn then c.out else [v]) := by
  cases hs : xstep P x ρ c with
  | inl c' =>
    obtain ⟨t, e, ht, hr, hd', he', hh, henv⟩ :=
      A.host_ordinary par (D.coin s c) T c c' o d hd he hs hcoin
        (D.word s c) (D.word_length s c) (D.word_head s c) (fun t => D.dispatch (s + t))
    let w := D.word s c t ++ [D.dispatch (s + t)]
    have hw : w.length = t + 1 := by
      rw [List.length_append, D.word_length, List.length_singleton]
    refine ⟨w, e, ?_, hr, ?_, ?_, ⟨he', hd', hh⟩⟩
    · rw [hw]
      exact (Nat.succ_le_succ ht).trans (A.phase_time_le _ _ _ _)
    · intro u hu j
      exact (henv u (by omega) j).trans (by exact_mod_cast (A.phase_radius_le
        (runPosition P c.pc) x.length W T.card))
    · intro χ hD
      obtain ⟨hword, hdispatch⟩ := (RunDriver.follows_iff D χ).mp hD
      rw [hw]
      change D.word s c t ++ [D.dispatch (s + t)] = runChoices χ s (t + 1)
      rw [hword s c t, hdispatch (s + t), runChoices_append χ s t 1, runChoices_one]
  | inr v =>
    obtain ⟨t, e, ht, hr, hd', ho, henv⟩ :=
      A.host_verdict par (D.coin s c) T c v o d hd he hs
        (D.word s c) (D.word_length s c) (D.word_head s c)
    let w := D.word s c t
    have hw : w.length = t := D.word_length s c t
    refine ⟨w, e, ?_, hr, ?_, ?_, ⟨hd', ho⟩⟩
    · rw [hw]
      exact ht.trans ((Nat.le_succ _).trans (A.phase_time_le _ _ _ _))
    · intro u hu j
      exact (henv u (by omega) j).trans (by exact_mod_cast (A.phase_radius_le
        (runPosition P c.pc) x.length W T.card))
    · intro χ hD
      rw [hw]
      exact ((RunDriver.follows_iff D χ).mp hD).1 s c t

end WordRAM.Sim.RunSetup
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/RAMSimulation/Sim/RunPhase.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.RAMSimulation.Sim.Phases
import TCSlib.Complexity.RAMSimulation.Sim.RunSlices

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Uniform instruction phases for the simulation host

An ordinary instruction exits to the next position or a jump target. A verdict instruction
halts. This file packages both interfaces into one finite phase family for the host.

## Main definitions

* `WordRAM.Sim.RunPhase`: a finite instruction phase with dispatch and resource clauses.

## Main results

The package keeps the two cases of the RAM step in its endpoint assertion, so the master
induction can use one phase family for deterministic and nondeterministic runs.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (Exercise 1.9; §2.1.2.)
-/

namespace WordRAM.Sim

open Turing

/-- A finite phase for `ins`: a live endpoint redirects to the next position (`false`) or the
jump target (`true`), and a verdict endpoint halts with the required output. The heads stay
within a fixed multiple of the table, word and input-length sizes. -/
structure RunPhase (a : ℕ) (fn : Bool) (ins : XInstr) where
  State : Type
  finiteState : Fintype State
  decidableState : DecidableEq State
  machine : NDTM 8 Bool State
  entry : State
  redirect : State → Option Bool
  cost : ℕ
  avoids_entry : isCoin ins = true →
    ∀ (b : Bool) (q : State) inp work, (machine.tr b q inp work).state ≠ some entry
  agrees : ∀ q : State, q ≠ entry ∨ isCoin ins = false →
    machine.tr false q = machine.tr true q
  correct : ∀ (b : Bool) {x : List Bool} {W : ℕ} (P : XProgram) (ρ : List Bool)
    (T : Finset ℤ) (c : XCfg W) (o : Fin 8 → ℤ) (d : Turing.Cfg 8 Bool State x),
    P.getD c.pc (.base .reject) = ins → (isCoin ins = true → ρ.getD c.rd false = b) →
    d.state = some entry → Encodes a fn T c (Function.Embedding.refl _) o d →
    ∃ (t : ℕ) (d' : Turing.Cfg 8 Bool State x),
      t ≤ cost * ((T.card + 1) * (W + 1) + W ^ 2 + x.length + 1) ∧
      (∀ u < t, ∀ q, ((machine.fixChoice b).runFrom d u).state = some q → redirect q = none) ∧
      (∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j : Fin 8, |((machine.fixChoice b).runFrom d u).workTapePos j - o j| ≤
        (cost * ((T.card + 1) * (W + 1) + (Nat.bits x.length).length + 1) : ℕ)) ∧
      (machine.fixChoice b).runFrom d t = d' ∧
      match xstep P x ρ c with
      | .inl c' => Encodes a fn (T ∪ ins.touches c.mem) c' (Function.Embedding.refl _) o d' ∧
          ∃ (q : State) (jump : Bool), d'.state = some q ∧ redirect q = some jump ∧
            c'.pc = if jump then jumpTarget ins else c.pc + 1
      | .inr v => d'.state = none ∧ d'.output = (if fn then c.out else [v])

attribute [instance] RunPhase.finiteState RunPhase.decidableState

/-- A non-verdict instruction has a uniform phase, obtained from `exists_phase` without
changing its machine or resource bounds.

**Proof sketch.** Redirect the two distinct exits to Boolean next/jump tags. The row's cut
excludes both exits before its endpoint. Its head displacement is measured from the origins
because `Encodes` places every head there. The RAM step and the endpoint encoding are exactly
the clauses of `exists_phase`. -/
theorem runPhase_of_instruction (a : ℕ) (fn : Bool) (ins : XInstr)
    (hins : ImmBound a ins) (hv : isVerdict ins = false) : Nonempty (RunPhase a fn ins) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, hfin, hdec, N, entry, next, jump, C, hne, hentry, hagree, hrow⟩ :=
    exists_phase a fn ins hins hv
  letI := hfin
  letI := hdec
  refine ⟨{
    State := S
    finiteState := hfin
    decidableState := hdec
    machine := N
    entry := entry
    redirect := fun q => if q = next then some false else if q = jump then some true else none
    cost := C
    avoids_entry := fun _ => hentry
    agrees := hagree
    correct := ?_ }⟩
  intro b x W P ρ T c o d hfetch hcoin hd he
  obtain ⟨c', d', hstep, he', hexit, hreach⟩ := hrow b P ρ T c o d hfetch hcoin hd he
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hcut, henv, hrun⟩ := (reachesWithin_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp hreach
  have hheads : ∀ j, d.workTapePos j = o j :=
      ((encodes_iff a fn T c (Function.Embedding.refl _) o d).mp he).1
  refine ⟨t, d', ht, ?_, ?_, hrun, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu q hq
    have hqn : q ≠ next := by
      intro h
      apply hcut u hu
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, hq, h]
      exact Or.inl True.intro
    have hqj : q ≠ jump := by
      intro h
      apply hcut u hu
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, hq, h]
      exact Or.inr True.intro
    simp only [if_neg hqn, if_neg hqj]
  · intro u hu j
    simpa only [hheads j] using henv u hu j
  · rw [hstep]
    refine ⟨he', ?_⟩
    rcases hexit with ⟨hs, hp⟩ | ⟨hs, hp⟩
    · exact ⟨next, false, hs, if_pos rfl, hp⟩
    · refine ⟨jump, true, hs, ?_, hp⟩
      simp only [if_neg hne.symm, if_true]

/-- A verdict instruction has a uniform phase with no redirects. Its deterministic verdict
machine is used under either choice, and its stationary heads satisfy every phase envelope.

**Proof sketch.** Use `exists_verdictPhase` and the deterministic embedding. The verdict row's
constant time is bounded by the phase formula because its size factor is at least one. Its
heads never move, and the encoding supplies their origins. -/
theorem runPhase_of_verdict (a : ℕ) (fn : Bool) (ins : XInstr) (v : Bool)
    (hcoin : isCoin ins = false)
    (hstep : ∀ {x : List Bool} {W : ℕ} (P : XProgram) (ρ : List Bool) (c : XCfg W),
      P.getD c.pc (.base .reject) = ins → xstep P x ρ c = .inr v) :
    Nonempty (RunPhase a fn ins) := by
  obtain ⟨S, hfin, hdec, M, entry, C, hrow⟩ := exists_verdictPhase fn v
  refine ⟨{
    State := S
    finiteState := hfin
    decidableState := hdec
    machine := M.toNDTM
    entry := entry
    redirect := fun _ => none
    cost := C
    avoids_entry := ?_
    agrees := ?_
    correct := ?_ }⟩
  · intro h
    simp only [hcoin, Bool.false_eq_true] at h
  · intro q _
    funext inp work
    rw [MultiTapeTM.toNDTM_tr, MultiTapeTM.toNDTM_tr]
  · intro b x W P ρ T c o d hfetch _ hd he
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hs, ho, hfixed⟩ := hrow a T c o d hd he
    have hheads : ∀ j, d.workTapePos j = o j :=
      ((encodes_iff a fn T c (Function.Embedding.refl _) o d).mp he).1
    refine ⟨t, M.runFrom d t, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply ht.trans
      rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
      exact Nat.le_add_left _ _
    · intro u hu q hq
      rfl
    · intro u hu j
      rw [runDet_fixChoice, hfixed u hu, hheads j, sub_self, abs_zero]
      exact Nat.cast_nonneg _
    · rw [runDet_fixChoice]
    · rw [hstep P ρ c hfetch]
      exact ⟨hs, ho⟩

/-- The verdict instructions are exactly `accept` and `reject`. -/
theorem runVerdict_cases (ins : XInstr) (h : isVerdict ins = true) :
    ins = .base .accept ∨ ins = .base .reject := by
  rcases ins with i | _ | _ | _ | _
  · cases i <;> simp_all only [isVerdict_def, reduceCtorEq, or_true, true_or]
  all_goals simp only [isVerdict_def, Bool.false_eq_true] at h

/-- Every instruction with bounded immediate addresses has a uniform finite simulation phase.
Ordinary instructions use `exists_phase`; the two verdicts use `exists_verdictPhase`. -/
theorem exists_runPhase (a : ℕ) (fn : Bool) (ins : XInstr) (hins : ImmBound a ins) :
    Nonempty (RunPhase a fn ins) := by
  cases hv : isVerdict ins with
  | false => exact runPhase_of_instruction a fn ins hins hv
  | true =>
    rcases runVerdict_cases ins hv with rfl | rfl
    · apply runPhase_of_verdict a fn (.base .accept) true
      · rw [isCoin_def]
      · intro x W P ρ c hfetch
        rw [xstep_def, hfetch]
    · apply runPhase_of_verdict a fn (.base .reject) false
      · rw [isCoin_def]
      · intro x W P ρ c hfetch
        rw [xstep_def, hfetch]

/-- Every branch of a uniform phase follows the deterministic slice selected by its first
bit. This includes the empty branch and verdict phases, whose choices always agree. -/
theorem RunPhase.branch_slice {a : ℕ} {fn : Bool} {ins : XInstr}
    (R : RunPhase a fn ins) {x : List Bool} (w : List Bool)
    (d : Turing.Cfg 8 Bool R.State x) :
    R.machine.runWith w d = (R.machine.fixChoice (w.headD false)).runFrom d w.length := by
  cases hc : isCoin ins with
  | false =>
    apply NDTM.runWith_eq_fixChoice_runFrom
    intro j hj q hq
    exact R.agrees q (Or.inr hc)
  | true =>
    cases w with
    | nil => rw [List.length_nil, NDTM.runWith_nil, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    | cons b w =>
      exact runWith_entry_slice R.machine R.entry (R.avoids_entry hc)
        (fun q hq => R.agrees q (Or.inl hq)) b w d

/-- Every prefix of a phase branch follows the slice selected by the original first bit.
The zero-length prefix is independent of that bit. -/
theorem RunPhase.branch_prefix {a : ℕ} {fn : Bool} {ins : XInstr}
    (R : RunPhase a fn ins) {x : List Bool} (w : List Bool)
    (d : Turing.Cfg 8 Bool R.State x) (u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ w.length) :
    R.machine.runWith (w.take u) d =
      (R.machine.fixChoice (w.headD false)).runFrom d u := by
  cases u with
  | zero => rw [List.take_zero, NDTM.runWith_nil, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
  | succ u =>
    cases w with
    | nil => rw [List.length_nil] at hu; omega
    | cons b w =>
      rw [List.take_succ_cons, R.branch_slice, List.length_cons,
        List.length_take_of_le (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hu)]

/-- A phase prefix follows any fixed choice agreeing with its first actual coin-entry bit.
No first-bit condition is needed for an empty branch or a non-coin instruction. -/
theorem RunPhase.branch_prefix_choice {a : ℕ} {fn : Bool} {ins : XInstr}
    (R : RunPhase a fn ins) {x : List Bool} (b : Bool) (w : List Bool)
    (d : Turing.Cfg 8 Bool R.State x)
    (hb : isCoin ins = true → w ≠ [] → w.headD false = b) (u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ w.length) :
    R.machine.runWith (w.take u) d = (R.machine.fixChoice b).runFrom d u := by
  cases hc : isCoin ins with
  | false =>
    have h := NDTM.runWith_eq_fixChoice_runFrom R.machine b (w.take u) d
      (fun _ _ q _ => R.agrees q (Or.inr hc))
    simpa only [List.length_take_of_le hu] using h
  | true =>
    cases w with
    | nil =>
      rw [List.length_nil] at hu
      have hz : u = 0 := by omega
      subst u
      rw [List.take_zero, NDTM.runWith_nil, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    | cons c w =>
      rw [R.branch_prefix _ d u hu, hb hc (fun h => List.noConfusion h)]

end WordRAM.Sim
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/RAMSimulation/Sim/RunPrefix.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.RAMSimulation.Sim.RunInstruction
import TCSlib.Complexity.RAMSimulation.Sim.RunSpace

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Certificates for prefixes of the shared simulation run

An execution certificate records an actual branch word, its exact source footprint, the
consumed coins, and one common time/head-envelope bound. Its source trace is valid for every
stream agreeing with those consumed coins; future bits need not be chosen in advance.

## Main definitions

* `WordRAM.Sim.RunExecution`: the invariant carried by the shared fuel induction.

## Main results

The endpoint is either a completed verdict or a live cutoff at the specified number of
ordinary source steps. Both kinds carry the same branch and resource certificate.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (Exercise 1.9; §2.1.2; Definition 4.1.)
-/

namespace WordRAM.Sim

open Turing

/-- A driven execution prefix. Its table cells are the initial set `T` together with exactly
the source trace's touched cells. Completed executions halt before the fuel cutoff; live
executions restore every head and remain at an encoded instruction entry. -/
structure RunExecution {P : XProgram} {fn : Bool} {Mw : FinTM Bool}
    (A : RunSetup P fn Mw) {W : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (D : RunDriver W)
    (B : ℕ → Bool → Prop) (s fuel : ℕ) (T : Finset ℤ) (c : XCfg W) (o : Fin 8 → ℤ)
    (d : Turing.Cfg (8 + A.extraTapes) Bool A.State x) (coins : List Bool) where
  word : List Bool
  finish : Turing.Cfg (8 + A.extraTapes) Bool A.State x
  steps : ℕ
  last : XCfg W
  cells : Finset ℤ
  outCoins : List Bool
  coins_extend : ∃ extra, outCoins = coins ++ extra
  coin_index : last.rd = outCoins.length
  coins_ok : RunCoinsSatisfy B outCoins
  source : ∀ ρ, RunCoinsAgree outCoins ρ → RunSourceTrace P x ρ steps c last cells
  run : A.host.runWith word d = finish
  time_bound : word.length ≤ (steps + 1) * A.blockTime x.length W (T ∪ cells).card
  envelope : ∀ u ≤ word.length, ∀ j,
    |(A.host.runWith (word.take u) d).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤
      (A.blockRadius x.length W (T ∪ cells).card : ℕ)
  follows : ∀ χ, D.Follows χ → word = runChoices χ s word.length
  ending :
    (∃ v, xstep P x outCoins last = .inr v ∧ finish.state = none ∧
      finish.output = (if fn then last.out else [v]) ∧ steps < fuel) ∨
    (steps = fuel ∧ ∃ par : Bool,
      finish.state = some ⟨some (runPosition P last.pc, par),
        (A.phases (runPosition P last.pc)).entry⟩ ∧
      Encodes A.width fn (T ∪ cells) last (Fin.castAddEmb A.extraTapes) o finish ∧
      finish.workTapePos = d.workTapePos)

/-- With zero fuel, the empty branch is a live cutoff at the original encoded entry.
It touches no source cells, consumes no coins and leaves every head fixed.

**Proof sketch.** Use the empty source trace and branch. The original entry and encoding give
the live cutoff; empty touched cells leave its table unchanged. Its sole prefix has zero
head displacement, and its time is zero. -/
theorem RunExecution.zero {P : XProgram} {fn : Bool} {Mw : FinTM Bool}
    (A : RunSetup P fn Mw) {W : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (D : RunDriver W)
    (B : ℕ → Bool → Prop) (s : ℕ) (T : Finset ℤ) (c : XCfg W) (o : Fin 8 → ℤ)
    (d : Turing.Cfg (8 + A.extraTapes) Bool A.State x) (coins : List Bool) (par : Bool)
    (hrd : c.rd = coins.length) (hc : RunCoinsSatisfy B coins)
    (hd : d.state = some ⟨some (runPosition P c.pc, par),
      (A.phases (runPosition P c.pc)).entry⟩)
    (he : Encodes A.width fn T c (Fin.castAddEmb A.extraTapes) o d) :
    Nonempty (RunExecution A D B s 0 T c o d coins) := by
  refine ⟨{
    word := []
    finish := d
    steps := 0
    last := c
    cells := ∅
    outCoins := coins
    coins_extend := ⟨[], (List.append_nil coins).symm⟩
    coin_index := hrd
    coins_ok := hc
    source := fun _ _ => RunSourceTrace.nil c
    run := NDTM.runWith_nil
    time_bound := Nat.zero_le _
    envelope := ?_
    follows := ?_
    ending := Or.inr ⟨rfl, par, hd, ?_, rfl⟩ }⟩
  · intro u hu j
    rw [List.length_nil] at hu
    have hz : u = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hu
    subst u
    rw [List.take_zero, NDTM.runWith_nil, sub_self, abs_zero]
    exact Nat.cast_nonneg _
  · intro χ hD
    rw [List.length_nil, runChoices_zero]
  · simpa only [Finset.union_empty] using he

/-- A driven verdict step is a completed execution certificate for any positive fuel.
It adds no ordinary source step, touched cell or consumed coin.

**Proof sketch.** Keep the given branch endpoint and envelope, and use the empty exact source
trace. `source_verdict_stream` makes the verdict valid for the unchanged consumed prefix.
The block bound is already the certificate's one-phase time bound; the source cell union is
unchanged because its newly touched set is empty. -/
theorem RunExecution.of_verdict {P : XProgram} {fn : Bool} {Mw : FinTM Bool}
    (A : RunSetup P fn Mw) {W : ℕ} {x ρ : List Bool} (D : RunDriver W)
    (B : ℕ → Bool → Prop) (s fuel : ℕ) (T : Finset ℤ) (c : XCfg W) (o : Fin 8 → ℤ)
    (d e : Turing.Cfg (8 + A.extraTapes) Bool A.State x) (coins w : List Bool) (v : Bool)
    (hrd : c.rd = coins.length) (hc : RunCoinsSatisfy B coins)
    (hs : xstep P x ρ c = .inr v) (hr : A.host.runWith w d = e)
    (he : e.state = none) (ho : e.output = (if fn then c.out else [v]))
    (ht : w.length ≤ A.blockTime x.length W T.card)
    (henv : ∀ u ≤ w.length, ∀ j,
      |(A.host.runWith (w.take u) d).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤
        (A.blockRadius x.length W T.card : ℕ))
    (hfollows : ∀ χ, D.Follows χ → w = runChoices χ s w.length) :
    Nonempty (RunExecution A D B s (fuel + 1) T c o d coins) := by
  refine ⟨{
    word := w
    finish := e
    steps := 0
    last := c
    cells := ∅
    outCoins := coins
    coins_extend := ⟨[], (List.append_nil coins).symm⟩
    coin_index := hrd
    coins_ok := hc
    source := fun _ _ => RunSourceTrace.nil c
    run := hr
    time_bound := ?_
    envelope := ?_
    follows := hfollows
    ending := Or.inl ⟨v, source_verdict_stream hs coins, he, ho, Nat.succ_pos fuel⟩ }⟩
  · simpa only [Finset.union_empty, zero_add, one_mul] using ht
  · simpa only [Finset.union_empty] using henv

/-- Prepending an ordinary instruction to a driven tail preserves the execution certificate.
The touched sets are unioned, coin prefixes extend, and the common head radius is taken over
the final table rather than added over instructions.

**Proof sketch.** Any stream agreeing with the tail's final coins agrees with the current
instruction's consumed bit, so `source_step_coin_congr` supplies the first source step.
Concatenate the branch words by `NDTM.runWith_append`. Monotonicity in table size bounds the
first block by the final block cost; the tail already has that bound. Restored heads let
`runEnvelope_append` keep the maximum radius. The tail's verdict or live cutoff gives the
corresponding endpoint, with one additional ordinary source step. -/
theorem RunExecution.prepend {P : XProgram} {fn : Bool} {Mw : FinTM Bool}
    (A : RunSetup P fn Mw) {W : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (D : RunDriver W)
    (B : ℕ → Bool → Prop) (s fuel : ℕ) (T : Finset ℤ) (c c' : XCfg W)
    (o : Fin 8 → ℤ) (d e : Turing.Cfg (8 + A.extraTapes) Bool A.State x)
    (coins w : List Bool) (b : Bool) (hrd : c.rd = coins.length)
    (hs : xstep P x (coins ++ [b]) c = .inl c')
    (hr : A.host.runWith w d = e) (hh : e.workTapePos = d.workTapePos)
    (ht : w.length ≤ A.blockTime x.length W T.card)
    (henv : ∀ u ≤ w.length, ∀ j,
      |(A.host.runWith (w.take u) d).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤
        (A.blockRadius x.length W T.card : ℕ))
    (hfollows : ∀ χ, D.Follows χ → w = runChoices χ s w.length)
    (R : RunExecution A D B (s + w.length) fuel
      (T ∪ (P.getD c.pc (.base .reject)).touches c.mem) c' o e
      (runNextCoins (P.getD c.pc (.base .reject)) coins b)) :
    Nonempty (RunExecution A D B s (fuel + 1) T c o d coins) := by
  let K := (P.getD c.pc (.base .reject)).touches c.mem
  have hcard : T.card ≤ (T ∪ (K ∪ R.cells)).card :=
    Finset.card_le_card Finset.subset_union_left
  refine ⟨{
    word := w ++ R.word
    finish := R.finish
    steps := R.steps + 1
    last := R.last
    cells := K ∪ R.cells
    outCoins := R.outCoins
    coins_extend := ?_
    coin_index := R.coin_index
    coins_ok := R.coins_ok
    source := ?_
    run := ?_
    time_bound := ?_
    envelope := ?_
    follows := ?_
    ending := ?_ }⟩
  · obtain ⟨pre, hp⟩ := runNextCoins_prefix (P.getD c.pc (.base .reject)) coins b
    obtain ⟨extra, he⟩ := R.coins_extend
    exact ⟨pre ++ extra, he.trans ((congrArg (fun z => z ++ extra) hp).trans
      (List.append_assoc coins pre extra))⟩
  · intro ρ hρ
    obtain ⟨extra, he⟩ := R.coins_extend
    have hn : RunCoinsAgree (runNextCoins (P.getD c.pc (.base .reject)) coins b) ρ :=
      runCoinsAgree_append_left _ extra ρ (by rw [← he]; exact hρ)
    have hfirst : xstep P x ρ c = .inl c' := by
      apply (source_step_coin_congr P x ρ (coins ++ [b]) c ?_).trans hs
      intro hcoin
      rw [hrd, runNextCoins_read _ _ _ _ hn hcoin,
        runCoinsAgree_append_bit coins (coins ++ [b]) b (runCoinsAgree_refl _)]
    exact RunSourceTrace.cons hfirst (R.source ρ hρ)
  · rw [NDTM.runWith_append, hr, R.run]
  · rw [List.length_append]
    have htail : R.word.length ≤
        (R.steps + 1) * A.blockTime x.length W (T ∪ (K ∪ R.cells)).card := by
      simpa only [Finset.union_assoc] using R.time_bound
    have hfirst := ht.trans (A.blockTime_mono x.length W hcard)
    calc
      w.length + R.word.length ≤ A.blockTime x.length W (T ∪ (K ∪ R.cells)).card +
          (R.steps + 1) * A.blockTime x.length W (T ∪ (K ∪ R.cells)).card :=
        Nat.add_le_add hfirst htail
      _ = (R.steps + 1 + 1) * A.blockTime x.length W (T ∪ (K ∪ R.cells)).card := by
        rw [Nat.add_mul (R.steps + 1) 1, one_mul, Nat.add_comm]
  · apply runEnvelope_append A.host w R.word d e _ hr hh
    · intro u hu j
      exact (henv u hu j).trans (by exact_mod_cast (A.blockRadius_mono x.length W hcard))
    · simpa only [Finset.union_assoc] using R.envelope
  · intro χ hD
    calc
      w ++ R.word = runChoices χ s w.length ++
          runChoices χ (s + w.length) R.word.length :=
        congrArg₂ List.append (hfollows χ hD) (R.follows χ hD)
      _ = runChoices χ s (w.length + R.word.length) :=
        (runChoices_append χ s w.length R.word.length).symm
      _ = runChoices χ s (w ++ R.word).length := by rw [List.length_append]
  · rcases R.ending with ⟨v, hv, hd, ho, hf⟩ | ⟨hf, par, hd, he, hheads⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨v, hv, hd, ho, Nat.succ_lt_succ hf⟩
    · refine Or.inr ⟨congrArg (fun n => n + 1) hf, par, hd, ?_, hheads.trans hh⟩
      simpa only [Finset.union_assoc] using he

/-- A halting RAM run rules out the execution certificate's live cutoff and bounds its exact
footprint. Its completed output is the output of that RAM run.

**Proof sketch.** `RunSourceTrace.bounded_by_halt` compares the certificate with the halting
witness, giving a strict bound below the fuel and inclusion in the witness's footprint. This
contradicts a live cutoff. For the remaining verdict, form a `HaltsWithin` witness from the
exact source trace and use the published `HaltsWithin.unique` to identify verdict and output. -/
theorem RunExecution.completed {P : XProgram} {fn : Bool} {Mw : FinTM Bool}
    {A : RunSetup P fn Mw} {W : ℕ} {x ρ : List Bool} {D : RunDriver W}
    {B : ℕ → Bool → Prop} {s t : ℕ} {T : Finset ℤ} {o : Fin 8 → ℤ}
    {d : Turing.Cfg (8 + A.extraTapes) Bool A.State x} {coins : List Bool}
    (R : RunExecution A D B s t T (XCfg.init W x.length) o d coins)
    {v : Bool} {out : List Bool} {f : ℕ}
    (h : HaltsWithin P x ρ W t v out f) (ha : RunCoinsAgree R.outCoins ρ) :
    R.steps < t ∧ R.cells.card ≤ f ∧ R.finish.state = none ∧
      R.finish.output = (if fn then out else [v]) := by
  obtain ⟨n, c₂, K, hn, hK, hr, hv, ho⟩ := (haltsWithin_iff P x ρ t v out f).mp h
  have htrace := R.source ρ ha
  obtain ⟨hsteps, hcells⟩ := htrace.bounded_by_halt hr hv
  have hlt : R.steps < t := hsteps.trans_lt hn
  have hcard : R.cells.card ≤ f := (Finset.card_le_card hcells).trans hK
  rcases R.ending with ⟨v', hv', hd, hout, _⟩ | ⟨hcut, _⟩
  · have hmade : HaltsWithin P x ρ W t v' R.last.out f :=
      (haltsWithin_iff P x ρ t v' R.last.out f).mpr
        ⟨R.steps, R.last, K, hlt, hK, htrace.to_stepsIn (↑K) hcells,
          source_verdict_stream hv' ρ, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨heqv, heqo⟩ := h.unique hmade
    exact ⟨hlt, hcard, hd, by rw [← heqv, ← heqo] at hout; exact hout⟩
  · omega

end WordRAM.Sim
```
